# Assignment Overview

This report documents the product catalog development work completed for the Shopify practice store prototype. The store concept is based on how the **CPP Farm Store** could present fresh produce, campus favorites, specialty foods, gifts, and student-friendly items in a clear ecommerce environment.

> **Key idea:** A product catalog is more than a product list. It helps customers understand what the store offers, compare options, evaluate value, and make purchase decisions.

::: callout-note
## Prototype Note

The products in this catalog are sample products inspired by CPP Farm Store and similar local grocery/farm retail businesses. Product images should be original, royalty-free, AI-generated, or clearly labeled placeholders for educational use.
:::

# Product Catalog Summary

For this assignment, I added a focused product assortment of **10 products** to the Shopify store. The assortment was designed to show how a Farm Store ecommerce catalog could support everyday shopping, seasonal browsing, gift purchasing, and campus-connected product discovery.

Table @tbl-product-list summarizes the catalog.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-product-list
#| tbl-cap: "Product list added to the Shopify practice store"
#| echo: false

products <- data.frame(
  Product = c(
    "CPP Farms Ice Cream",
    "Farm Store Gift Basket",
    "Custom Gift Box",
    "Breakfast Theme Gift Box",
    "Avocado / Satsuma Fruit Box",
    "Seasonal Produce Box",
    "Raw Local Honey",
    "Farm Store Salsa",
    "Local Cold Brew",
    "Student Snack Pack"
  ),
  Category = c(
    "CPP Favorites / Student Snacks & Drinks",
    "Gifts",
    "Gifts",
    "Gifts",
    "Fresh Produce / Gifts",
    "Fresh Produce / Seasonal Bundles",
    "Specialty Foods",
    "Specialty Foods",
    "Student Snacks & Drinks",
    "Student Snacks & Drinks"
  ),
  Price = c(
    "Half Pint: $2.99; Pint: $5.99",
    "$65.00",
    "$40.00 and up",
    "$50.00",
    "$40.00",
    "$25.00",
    "$8.99",
    "$6.99",
    "$4.99",
    "$7.99"
  ),
  Inventory = c(
    "Tracked by variant",
    "Limited stock",
    "Made to order",
    "Limited stock",
    "Seasonal availability",
    "Seasonal availability",
    "In stock",
    "In stock",
    "In stock",
    "In stock"
  ),
  Tags = c(
    "cpp-favorite, student-friendly, pickup-only",
    "gift-basket, pickup-only",
    "gift-box, pickup-available",
    "gift-box, pickup-available",
    "seasonal, pickup-available, gift-box",
    "seasonal, pickup-available",
    "specialty-food, pickup-available",
    "specialty-food, pickup-available",
    "student-friendly, pickup-available",
    "student-friendly, pickup-available"
  )
)

knitr::kable(products)
```

# Product Evidence by Category {.tabset}

## CPP Favorites

### CPP Farms Ice Cream

**Product role:** Campus favorite and student-friendly frozen product.

**Product description:** CPP Farms Ice Cream is a campus-favorite frozen treat inspired by the CPP Farm Store experience. It highlights the store's connection to Cal Poly Pomona, local agriculture, and student community favorites. The product includes two variants: **Half Pint** and **Pint**. Because it is a frozen product, it is listed as **pickup only**.

**Recommended Shopify fields:**

-   Product type: Frozen Dessert
-   Vendor: CPP Farm Store
-   Collections: Featured Products, CPP Favorites, Student Snacks & Drinks
-   Tags: `cpp-favorite`, `student-friendly`, `pickup-only`
-   Variants: Half Pint and Pint

![CPP Farms Ice Cream product page or admin page](images/photo%201.png){#fig-ice-cream}

## Gifts

### Farm Store Gift Basket

**Product role:** Main gift-oriented product for holidays, alumni, families, and campus visitors.

**Product description:** A Farm Store gift basket featuring a curated mix of local goods, snacks, sauces, jams, drinks, and seasonal favorites. The basket supports high-intent gift buyers and reinforces the Farm Store's local and community-centered brand.

**Recommended Shopify fields:**

-   Product type: Gift Basket
-   Vendor: CPP Farm Store
-   Collection: Gifts
-   Tags: `gift-basket`, `pickup-only`
-   Fulfillment note: Requires 1--2 business days for preparation

![Farm Store Gift Basket product page](images/photo%202.png){#fig-gift-basket}

### Custom Gift Box

**Product role:** Flexible gift option for customers who want to request specific item types.

**Product description:** A customizable Farm Store gift box that allows customers to request preferred items such as honey, jam, fruit preserves, candy, CPP branded items, and seasonal goods. Final items may vary based on inventory availability.

**Recommended Shopify fields:**

-   Product type: Gift Box
-   Vendor: CPP Farm Store
-   Collection: Gifts
-   Tags: `gift-box`, `pickup-available`

![Custom Gift Box product page](images/photo%203.png){#fig-custom-gift-box}

### Breakfast Theme Gift Box

**Product role:** Occasion-based gift product built around a morning/breakfast theme.

**Product description:** A curated gift box designed around breakfast and morning favorites. This product could include coffee, honey, jam, snacks, and other Farm Store items suitable for a thoughtful local gift.

**Recommended Shopify fields:**

-   Product type: Gift Box
-   Vendor: CPP Farm Store
-   Collection: Gifts
-   Tags: `gift-box`, `pickup-available`

![Breakfast Theme Gift Box product page](images/photo%204.png){#fig-breakfast-box}

# Product Description Quality

The product descriptions were written to be customer-friendly rather than vague. Each description explains what the product is, why it fits the Farm Store concept, and how the customer might use it. For example, gift products include preparation expectations, frozen products are marked as pickup-only, and seasonal products explain that availability may vary. This helps customers make informed decisions before adding items to their cart.

::: callout-important
## Customer Clarity

For grocery and farm store ecommerce, customers need more than a product title. They need clear information about pickup, availability, preparation time, product substitutions, and whether the item is seasonal or limited.
:::

# Assortment Strategy Reflection

The product assortment was designed around a focused Farm Store ecommerce experience rather than a full inventory catalog. The catalog includes fresh produce, CPP favorites, specialty foods, gift products, and student-friendly snacks and drinks. These products belong together because they represent different customer needs: everyday campus convenience, seasonal produce discovery, local specialty shopping, and occasion-based gifting. This assortment supports the store concept by showing how Shopify could organize products into clear collections that help customers browse, compare, and purchase without feeling overwhelmed. Of course with better understanding of total SKUs and product porfolio we wil consider enhancing product collections to better reflect store inventory.

# CPP Farm Store Application Reflection

CPP Farm Store should present products online in a way that makes product discovery and pickup expectations clear. Customers should be able to quickly understand what is available, what is seasonal, what can be picked up, and what requires preparation time. Gift baskets and custom boxes should include clear notes about inventory substitutions, pickup timing, and item requests. Fresh produce should emphasize seasonality and availability. Student-friendly items should be easy to find for quick purchases. Overall, CPP Farm Store should use product pages, collection pages, badges, and descriptions to reduce confusion and connect the online shopping experience to the in-store Farm Store journey.[^1]

[^1]: This is especially important for perishable, frozen, or gift products because customers may need extra information before committing to an order.
